name: Unsung Heroes 1898
detailed_description:
Unsung Heroes 1898 is a first-person shooter set during the overlooked yet pivotal Spanish-American War. Engage in large-scale, dynamic battles across the Philippines, Cuba, and Puerto Rico — where history can be relived or rewritten. Step into the boots of any soldier on the field and experience this forgotten chapter of warfare from a bold new perspective.

The Battlefield is Yours — Be Anyone.

Take control of the battlefield with Combatant Shift — a dynamic mechanic that lets you seamlessly swap between any allied infantry, officer, or artillery crew at any moment. Every unit brings its own strengths, weaknesses, and tactical role. Victory doesn't belong to a single hero — it takes a full army, and you're in command of them all.

Open-Ended Battles — Command Your War

Each battlefield is chaotic, unforgiving, and fully in your hands. Choose your strategies and lead the charge from the ground, adapting in real time as the tide of war shifts around you. With non-linear objectives and full tactical freedom, victory is never handed to you. You'll have to earn it.

Truth in Every Trigger. History in Every Step.

Every weapon, uniform, and battle in Unsung Heroes 1898 is crafted with care and historical precision — built from real-world references to bring this overlooked war to life. Fight through faithfully recreated battles, or slow things down in Museum Mode, an interactive space where you can explore artifacts and stories from the war. Whether you're here to engage or to learn, this is history like you've never played it before.

Forge the Future Together

Your voice matters on this battlefield. As Unsung Heroes 1898 launches in Early Access, community feedback will play a vital role in shaping the game's evolution. From balancing gameplay to refining features, your input helps steer development. With upcoming mod tools and a full map editor, you'll be able to create your own battles and expand the experience far beyond the base game.

Key Features

  • Fight on large scale maps and strategize with near unrestricted freedom. Each map is hand-made to be as historically-accurate as possible.

  • Take control of not just one, but all allied soldiers with Combatant Shift. Fight not as a one-man army, but amongst allies and brothers-in-arms.

  • Engage in three different types of combatants with unique gameplay elements and tactical roles: infantry, artillery, and cavalry.

  • Experience authentic weaponry, featuring custom models and animations.

  • Play in offline single-player a full campaign mode that takes you across all the major land battles of the Spanish-American War (not available on initial Early Access release) or play on maps against bots with custom rules.

  • Create maps and battles or download community-made mods with Steam Workshop support.

  • Join in a growing community to help shape the most accurate depiction of the Spanish-American War put into a game ever.

short_description: Unsung Heroes 1898 drops you into the heart of the Spanish-American War; a conflict fueled by imperialism, propaganda, and the sacrifices of those caught in its wake. From the jungles of Cuba to the hills of Puerto Rico, engage in major land battles that shaped a turning point in American history.
